notes.domain: No verifyingContract and no salt, so picks can be signed before the contract exists. viem: pass the domain exactly as above (do not add verifyingContract). Wallets do not need to be on chain 4663 to sign.
notes.typehash: keccak256("Pick(bytes32 round,uint8 side,int32 spreadBp,uint8 slot,uint64 signedAt)") = 0xf3c5af7de644c729f50768352cffd36464af7a49980efda107d3767588c13da3
notes.round: Round id = the round name as UTF-8, right-padded with zeros to 32 bytes (viem stringToHex(name, { size: 32 }); cast format-bytes32-string). Names: D-YYYY-MM-DD, ELECTION-2026. The same bytes32 is the id in openRound/anchor/settle and in the leaf.
notes.side: uint8: 0 = RED, 1 = BLUE. Must agree with the sign of spreadBp (0 allowed for either side). Checked by the server, not the contract.
notes.spreadBp: int32 in [-2000, 2000], predicted RED minus BLUE in basis points.
notes.slot: uint8, 0-based (0 for everyone; holders 0..2 in ELECTION-2026). Suggested convention, the server owns it.
notes.signedAt: uint64 unix seconds chosen by the signer's client; the server rejects values far from its own clock and after picksClose.
notes.picker: The leaf's picker is the address recovered from the signature (viem verifyTypedData / recoverTypedDataAddress).
notes.leaf: OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree: leaf = keccak256(bytes.concat(keccak256(abi.encode(round, picker, slot, side, spreadBp, signedAt)))). JS: StandardMerkleTree.of(values, leafEncoding) with each value = [round, picker, slot, side, spreadBp, signedAt] (in leafFields order). On chain: RaceBook.leafHash(...) and RaceBook.verify(round, n, leaf, proof).
notes.viem: signTypedData({ domain, types: { Pick: types.Pick }, primaryType: 'Pick', message }) with signedAt as BigInt (uint64) and side/slot/spreadBp as numbers.
